pages.title: Casimir Vacuum Press
pages.text: The $(item)Casimir Vacuum Press$() squeezes matter between plates so close that the vacuum itself pushes back.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.

The physics is real. Between two plates only certain vacuum fluctuations fit, so there are fewer inside than out, and the plates are pressed together. Casimir predicted it in 1948; it was measured in 1997. I find that both reassuring and unsettling.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Casimir Plate, Degenerate Armour Plate, Degenerate Matter Chunk, Hawking Absorber Plate, Lattice Seed Crystal, Metamaterial Substrate, Neutronium Plate, Quadrupole Pole Tip, Quantum Dot, Solar Statite.
